import asyncio
import concurrent.futures
import logging
import pytest

from tornado.concurrent import future_set_exception_unless_cancelled


def test_future_sets_exception_when_not_cancelled():
    """When the future is not cancelled, the exception is set on it."""
    fut = asyncio.Future()
    exc = ValueError("test error")
    future_set_exception_unless_canceled(fut, exc)
    assert fut.exception() is exc
    assert fut.done()
    assert not fut.cancelled()
